blind.why: Top-down coverage overlay vs a reference polygon navmesh. Ours covers every lane from wall to wall, with named callout areas and route lines, so it tells you more. The reference has smoother polygon borders. Ours was easy to identify, so this pair was only partly blind.

Spawn-to-site route-time bars drawn in the same format. Both have about a 9 s defender margin. Ours has the same time to both sites (16.0/15.7 s vs 7.2/6.8 s). The CS2 Mirage numbers are uneven, which gives the map character. This was close to a coin flip, and the CS2 values are approximate.

Ours: first-person view from holdSpots(A site, toward Terrace) pick #1. The bot stands in the open middle of the plaza, 2 m from site centre, and the threat sees its whole body (exposure 1.0). CS2 (rain, t2_003): the angle is held from inside a doorway with the body behind cover.

biggest_gap: holdSpots picks exposed open-ground spots, and what it picks depends on query history. (1) The ~1031 spot sight profiles are never precomputed after a synchronous build: NavSystem.build() sets this.bg=null after _buildGen queues precomputeProfiles, and boot uses build(). Measured at boot plus 5 s: spots.have = 0/1031, bg=false. holdSpots then gives unprofiled spots a default exposure of 0.5, so it prefers them over profiled spots with real exposure. B site toward Upper Tunnel (-31.25,0,-4.25): picks without profiles are (-32.75,-34.25), (-30.75,-34.25), (-33.25,-36.25), all expo 0.5. With full profiles they become (-35.25,-36.75) and (-37.25,-34.75). Results change after rebuild (determinism hash 695674811 -> -686531202 on an unchanged graph). (2) The score never uses how much of the holder's body the threat can see. All 3 B picks are fully visible (nav.exposure(threat,spot)=1.0), and A pick #1 is in the open plaza. Fix: keep bg after a sync build, or finish profiles in it. Add a term for exposure(threat, spot) so head-only spots behind boxes or door frames win. Prefer off-angles. CS2-style holds are a doorframe or box edge, not open floor.
other_gaps: Traversal with the real movement sim and a bot-like follower (same reach/corner-cut/jump rules as brain.follow): 136 of 2000 random pairs (6.8%) stall at least 1.5 s on the first attempt. Named spawn-to-callout/site routes: 4 of 700. 3 of 2700 never recover after 2 replans. Main hotspots: the B-site drop link (-38.25,0.66,-34.75)->(-37.25,-1.4,-34.75) over the railing (28 cases); the A jump/mantle at (25.25,2.02,-31.75) (22); the crate-corner waypoint (-5.25,0,-3.75) (8); the ember spawn -> Lower Tunnel route snagging at (-31.25,0,39.94).

The tactical queries ignore smoke. With a live haze between the points, nav.visible returns false, but holdSpots(B, A) returns 3 spots with visible:true (realVis=false for all 3) and coverPoints is unchanged. Use hooks.blocksLine in holdSpots' visibility test.

Unrecoverable mantle chains: paths up 0.8 m and then 1.4 m stacked jump links at (-15.25,2.2,47.25) (Tunnel Approach) and (-14.25,2.8,-38.75). The sim ends at the wall base on y=0. Validate jump chains with the real sim, or forbid jump->jump chains with no flat run-up.
Hop-over paths are 111 of 2000 (5.5%) in the validator, not the ~3% claimed. The worst detour ratio is x9.45.

Boot build runs synchronously on the main thread: 0.6-0.83 s CPU (CDP ThreadTime), 7-18 s wall on this loaded box. Path cost is fine on average (242 us CPU, ~338 expansions mean, p99 2339). The 30 worst pairs cost 1.1 ms CPU each, or 1.8 ms with danger weighting, and bots call path() synchronously.
nav.config.runSpeed is 6.3 but the player runSpeed is 7.2, so eta and sitesToSpawnRouteTimes overstate times by about 14% unless that is intentional for the equipped weapon.
bugs: NavSystem.build() discards the background profile precompute (this.bg=null): after boot 0/1031 spot profiles exist, which makes holdSpots quality depend on history and changes results after a rebuild
holdSpots reports visible:true for threats behind live smoke
strengths: 100% reachability: 2000/2000 validator pairs with 0 clipping, 0 floating and 0 failures, and 2700/2700 sim-walked pairs reachable
Real 5v5 bot matches (2 seeds, 12 rounds): 0 stuck incidents, 0 null paths, 0 page errors, in-match path() p50 0.1 ms
Smoke-aware visible/exposure follow the haze lifetime correctly (blocked 0-16.5 s, clear at 18 s)
Cover points are truly hidden (exposure 0 from the threat), hard cover, with peek spots
Coverage: sim-dropped probes on reachable levels found 0/579 standable spots with no node within 1 m
